about_the_game:
Shadowbound is a journey through minimalist 3D environments, where light is your enemy and shadow your only ally.

It has always been grey. You walk aimlessly, searching for a place to stop, rest, and leave the bad behind so you can move forward.

Each level is a short, direct challenge with no distractions: jump, advance, and reach the shadow that will allow you to continue.

Key features:
· Shadow is your only ally, and light is your enemy.
· Minimalist black-and-white environments.
· Short, direct levels with no distractions.
· Puzzles that play with light and shadow.
· Motivational phrases between worlds.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Linux 64-bit (Ubuntu 20.04 or later)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD R7 260X / Intel UHD 630 (OpenGL 3.3 or higher)
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Linux 64-bit (Ubuntu 22.04 or later)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 / Intel Arc A380
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
